identity.industry: Engineering & Fabrication for Power Transmission / Grid & Renewable Infrastructure (galvanized steel structures)

summary.oneLiner: A vertically-integrating, multi-product galvanized-steel fabricator (KP Group) riding India's grid + renewable + telecom capex with ~100% revenue CAGR over 5 years, low utilization (~30%) leaving large embedded operating leverage — but with SME-board governance overhang (2% promoter royalty, group-company orders, debt-funded inventory build).

one-line thesis: A vertically-integrating, multi-product galvanized-steel fabricator (KP Group) riding India's grid + renewable + telecom capex with ~100% revenue CAGR over 5 years, low utilization (~30%) leaving large embedded operating leverage — but with SME-board governance overhang (2% promoter royalty, group-company orders, debt-funded inventory build).
financial scorecard (consolidated):
| Metric | FY26 | FY25 | YoY |
|---|---|---|---|
| Total income | ₹1,250 cr | ₹702 cr | +78% |
| EBITDA | ₹249 cr | ₹115 cr | +117% |
| EBITDA margin | 20% | 16% | +400 bps |
| PAT | ₹136 cr | ₹73 cr | +85% |
| Order book (31-Mar-26) | ₹1,831 cr | — | — |
| **H2 FY26 income** | ₹714 cr | ₹436 cr | +64% |
| **H2 FY26 EBITDA** | ₹147 cr | — | +108% |
| **H2 FY26 PAT** | ₹77 cr | — | +68% |
| CFO (FY26) | ₹155 cr | — | — |

- 5-yr CAGR: ~100% revenue, ~136% net profit (mgmt claim).
- One-offs/notes: Other income fell to ~₹0 in H2 (IPO-fund FD interest now exhausted — funds deployed to capex). Cash & equivalents dropped ₹162 cr → ₹19 cr, explained as Ind-AS reclassification of >1yr FDs (~₹59 cr FY26 / ~₹52 cr FY25) into "other financial assets," not real cash burn. First time crossing ₹1,000 cr revenue.
guidance (next period):
- **No formal quarterly guidance** (half-yearly reporting; mgmt may switch to quarterly near main-board migration). Verify: next disclosure is H1 FY27 (~Nov 2026), not a quarter.
- Growth: minimum 40–50% YoY through 2030 (CMD vision); FY27 could be higher ("no limit" if capacity utilized). FY26 itself grew ~100%.
- EBITDA margin: guided **16–20% range**, will not commit to holding 20%.
- Entire ₹1,831 cr order book targeted for execution within FY27.
order book & pipeline:
- Confirmed order book ~₹1,831 cr (incl. landmark **₹819 cr+ BSNL telecom** order — strategic re-entry into telecom with long-term O&M annuity income).
- A separate ₹500 cr order is **included** within the 1,831 (mgmt clarified twice; book is NOT 2,300). Difference vs investor perception is LOA timing — PPT counts won tenders; BSE disclosure waits for Letter of Award.
- Bidding pipeline >₹3,000 cr (discussion stage, unconfirmed). Tender success ratio ~60–70%.
- Sector mix of pipeline: power & transmission first, telecom second, then roads/highways.
- Internal (KP Group) orders = ~22–25% of book; rest external.
segment / subsidiary:
- Standalone company, no cross-holding; first company Dr. Faruk Patel started.
- Verticals: transmission towers (approved 16+ states); poles & lighting (multiple state/municipal approvals); solar structures (approved by Nextracker & GameChange Solar); heavy engineering (RDSO approved → railway); PEB (executed a transformer factory + a solar-module factory); crash barriers (first in India to pass all 3 crash tests — car/bus/truck — for W-beam & Thrie-beam first attempt, NATRAX certified).
growth verticals / optionality:
- New products (mostly R&D/nascent): onshore & offshore tubular towers, container manufacturing (incl. **battery containers for data centers**), aluminium extrusions, fasteners ("magni fastener"), rolling mill, cables & conductors.
- Data center: aspirational — supplying battery containers / power-related materials; KPI Green & KP Energy (group) in discussions for green power. End-to-end-solution playbook (like renewables: MMS + evacuation towers + substations).
- Defence: at tender/discussion stage only, no concrete order yet.
margins & cost dynamics:
- 20% EBITDA margin in FY26 is "one of the healthiest in industry"; attributed to product diversification, customization (vs tonnage-based peers), economies of scale.
- Raw material escalation >5% passed through in larger contracts; other contracts hedged via pre-bought inventory.
- Fuel (coal, gas/LPG for galvanizing) is the key cost risk amid Middle East geopolitical disruption. Green hydrogen blended 20–25% into LPG at galvanizing plant — modest cost benefit, ESG + competitive differentiation, claimed "one of its kind."
capex / expansion:
- Capacity now **4,00,500 MTPA** (up ~4x from ~1 lakh MT, IPO-funded — ₹190 cr, "biggest BSE SME IPO ever").
- FY26 utilization only ~30–34% (volume 1,24,500 MT) → large embedded operating leverage.
- FY27 utilization guided ~50–60%; long-horizon (4–5 yr) capex philosophy justifies the upfront big build.
- FY27 capex mostly **backward integration** (rolling mill = own raw material) to improve margins/availability; nascent/internal-discussion stage. Plus small bolt-on capacity additions as diversification demands.
capital allocation:
- **2% promoter royalty** on top line (vs SEBI-permitted 5%) paid to Dr. Faruk Patel for KP Group brand; on ₹3,000 cr revenue that's ~₹60 cr — investor pushed back (B2B vs B2C brand logic); mgmt defended as brand-building expense borne directly by promoter (incl. cricket-team associate sponsorship, Delhi Capitals-style).
- No plan to be debt-free — prefers cheap debt (avg borrowing 8.5–9%, "A" rating) over equity dilution during growth phase. Long-term D/E low vs peers; FY26 debt rise is short-term working-capital for inventory build, not long-term.
- Main-board migration intended once SEBI criteria (~3-yr) met (following KP Energy / KPI Green path).
risks & watch-items:
- **Working capital stretch**: inventory days jumped ~96 → ~195; cash conversion cycle ~150 days. Justified as deliberate steel/raw-material stockpiling hedge against geopolitical supply/price risk — but is debt-funded.
- Finance cost up ~4x YoY (interest), funded by working-capital limits (banks, no venture debt).
- Cash collapse (₹162 → ₹19 cr) explained as reclassification — believe but verify in audited B/S.
- Governance/related-party: 2% royalty, 22–25% group-company orders, promoter-borne brand spends.
- Fuel/geopolitical cost shocks; margin not guaranteed at 20%.
- SME-board, half-yearly reporting = low disclosure granularity; investors repeatedly requested quarterly numbers.
- H1 was stronger than H2 within FY26 (billing-timing + fuel hurdle).
management quality / tone: - Confident, growth-evangelical; CFO Salim Yahoo fielded almost all questions articulately. Repeated deference to CMD Dr. Faruk Patel. Handled tough royalty/governance pushback transparently (acknowledged it "helped clarify"). Candid about not committing to 20% margin and about inventory being a deliberate bet. Some answers vague on defence/data-center specifics (early-stage).
non-obvious takeaways:
- The ₹819 cr BSNL telecom order single-handedly skews FY27 product mix toward telecom and brings annuity O&M income — a structural shift from pure fabrication toward execution/forward integration.
- Green-hydrogen galvanizing is more a differentiation/ESG narrative than a material cost lever (mgmt admits "small extent").
- The cash "decline" is largely reclassification optics — CFO operations were strong (₹155 cr CFO); real story is WC absorption into inventory, not erosion of profitability.
- ~30% utilization on a 4x-expanded base means revenue can roughly double again before needing the next major capex — the operating-leverage runway is the real bull case.
- Approval moats (16+ states, RDSO, NATRAX, Nextracker/GameChange) are the durable barrier, not the steel itself.
challenges → beneficiaries & losers:
| Challenge | Beneficiary stock(s) | Loser | Why / conviction |
|---|---|---|---|
| India grid/transmission capex surge (16+ state approvals) | 544150 · 544150 | Single-product tonnage tower players | Multi-product + Asia's largest galvanizing plant lets KPGEL bid wider; High |
| BSNL ₹819 cr telecom tower + O&M re-entry | 544150 · 544150 | Pure telecom-passive peers (code unverified) | Adds annuity O&M income, diversifies away from project lumpiness; High |
| Solar capex / renewable integration | 544150 · 544150 | — | Approved by Nextracker (code unverified) & GameChange Solar (code unverified); supplies MMS, evacuation towers, substations; Med-High |
| Data-center power/battery-container demand | 544150 · 544150 (aspirational) | — | Only plan-stage; group cos KPI Green (code unverified)/KP Energy (code unverified) in talks; Low |
| Fuel/geopolitical (Middle East) cost shock | — | 544150 · 544150 | Galvanizing fuel-intensive; margin & execution risk; Med |
| Steel raw-material price/availability volatility | 544150 · 544150 (via rolling-mill backward integration) | Non-integrated fabricators | Planned rolling mill secures input & margin; Med (execution pending) |
| Working-capital/debt intensity & WC cycle stretch | — | 544150 · 544150 | Inventory days 96→195, interest +4x, debt-funded; Med |

qoq change log: First tracked entry (no prior summary in repo). Baseline established at H2 FY26 / FY26: revenue ₹1,250 cr (+78%), EBITDA margin 20%, PAT ₹136 cr (+85%), order book ₹1,831 cr (incl. ₹819 cr BSNL), capacity 4,00,500 MTPA at ~30–34% utilization, Asia's largest hot-dip galvanizing plant (90,000 MTPA, 15 MT single-dip) commissioned at Matar. Key forward markers to track next call: FY27 utilization (target 50–60%), inventory-days normalization, finance-cost trajectory, BSNL order execution pace, main-board migration progress, defence/data-center order conversion.

themes.title: Power transmission & renewable-evacuation capex
themes.need: Grid build-out to evacuate ~90 GW of new renewables is the broadest theme in the universe - pulling EHV/765kV transmission EPC, towers, conductors, OPGW, cables and HVDC. POWERGRID/ADANIENSOL TBCB pipeline plus state RDSS/underground-cabling capex (Rajesh Power 544291, OMPOWER) underpins multi-year visibility for EPC, tower (KP Green 544150, SKIPPER) and conductor/cable makers (KEI, RRKABEL, DYCL).
themes.driver: Fresh TBCB awards + execution ramp; EPC order inflows over next 1-2 quarters.
